memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground." - Gen 1:28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Having made human beings in His image, God's first act towards them is to bless them. Before He gives them any task, He gives them His blessing. This is the heart of God, He delights in His people and desires good for them. Everything He calls them to flows out of that blessing.

Then God gives humanity a purpose: to be fruitful, to fill the earth, and to rule over creation as His stewards. This is often called the "cultural mandate", God's call to fill the world and care for it wisely on His behalf. Notice that we are given real responsibility. God entrusts His good world to our hands, to tend and manage, not to exploit or destroy.

There is dignity in this. Your daily work, whether caring for a home, raising children, farming, building, teaching, or serving, is part of God's good design for humanity to fill and steward His world. Ordinary work is not small in God's eyes; it is part of the calling He gave from the beginning.

Sadly, sin has twisted the way humanity rules, often bringing harm instead of care. But in Christ, the perfect Man, we see how to steward God's world with love and wisdom. As we follow Him, we learn to rule creation the way God intended, under His blessing and for His glory (1 Cor 10:31).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you see your daily work and responsibilities as part of God's good calling?
2. How can you care for God's world and the people in it more faithfully?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for blessing me and giving me meaningful work to do. Help me steward all You have entrusted to me with wisdom, care, and love for Your glory. Amen.
